build_optimizer_sgd: build an SGD optimizer with weight decay groups for a PyTorch model using config args
build_lr_scheduler_cosine: build a warmup cosine learning rate scheduler for a PyTorch optimizer from config args
build_lr_scheduler_multistep: build a warmup multi-step exponential decay learning rate scheduler from config args
build_lr_scheduler_linear: build a warmup linear decay learning rate scheduler for a PyTorch optimizer from config args
build_lr_scheduler_constant: build a constant learning rate scheduler that keeps the optimizer learning rate unchanged
